notes.title: March to Glory has been updated to versio 1.5
notes.content:
Hi all,

[b]March to Glory[/b] has been updated to version [b]1.5.0![/b] 

[b]Features[/b]:
Custom map - Added the ability to place both armies on the battlefield (player & AI).
HotSeat - Two players can now customize and play any battle on the same device.
Cancel multiplayer challenge. Any game can be cancelled if no other player has joined.


[b]Bugfix[/b]:
- Game freeze in multiplayer replay.
- The game is lost if the number of turns has expired.
- "Play" button not working (more testing)
- Borodino map A.I freeze.

notes.title: [i]March to Glory[/i] has been updated to [b]version 1.4!
notes.content:
Hi all,

[i]March to Glory[/i] has been updated to [b]version 1.4![/b] 

[b]Change log:[/b]
-Localisation
Skirmish mode Single & Multiplayer: the players get to choose if they want to place the units manually on the map, default is ON
-Acquired Unity licence & removed the "Unity splash screen logo"
-Removed Line vs column shooting bonus
-Fixed artillery reaction fire (artillery has reaction fire only if it did not moved the turn prior)
-Artillery LOS tweaked (not perfect yet)
-Cavalry charges (when the infantry forms square deals only morale damage). If the cavalry attacks infantry that cannot form square, the damage is mostly permanent (red). 
-Fixed wrong briefing dates for Austerlitz and Jena
-Increasedofight to all unit by 1
-Cavalry in woods - less damage
- Healing: The way the unit heal now is -if an enemy is adjacent, the unit will heal +1, if an enemy is not adjacent he unit heals +2(or more). If a general or the unit is garrisoned the it will recover better and fully in the case of towns.

notes.title: Spread the Revolution or fight against it! March to Glory is OUT on Steam
notes.content:
[i]Napoleon is a torrent which as yet we are unable to stem. Moscow will be the sponge that will suck him dry.'' [/i]- Prince Mikhail Illarionovich Golenishchev-Kutuzov, Field Marshal of the Russian Empire

https://youtu.be/SRpE4vjzF-g

Napoleon Bonaparte seems unstoppable. His military genius combined with the revolutionary fire of his troops has crushed every enemy that stood against him. He has already proved his ability against the Austrians in northern Italy, and now, as Emperor is ready to overthrow every European kingdom.

Is he the Son of the Revolution, the bringer of freedom for all the people under the Ancien-Regimes, or a full of ambitions tyrant? Whatever the answer is, it is clear that only on the battlefield Europe’s destiny will be defined.

March to Glory, the new wargame from Shenandoah Studio, is out!

notes.title: March to Glory available on Slitherine - Steam Release delay
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

March to Glory has been released on Slitherine: http://www.slitherine.com/products/product.asp?gid=710

Unfortunately, steam players will need to wait a couple of days more, for a little issue within the Steam build has prevented us to release it here. 

We have taken the decision to release the game nevertheless on our site so to give players who want to play the game the opportunity to do so without any delay.

But do not worry! The game version sold on Slitherine is the same of the steam one, and if you buy the game from our site you will be able to unlock the game on Steam as well (when it will be out here). See here for more details: http://www.slitherine.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=87&t=72513

We know this is not 100% satisfying but we thought this was the best choice for everyone at the moment.

We apologize for every inconvenience.

Regards

notes.title: March To Glory - Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
It has been decided.

[b]March To Glory[/b], our next Napoleonic game, shall be released next month, the [b]12th of April[/b]!

[b]March To Glory[/b] is a turn-based strategy game that takes you through the Napoleonic wars with a new strategic and challenging gameplay, full of interesting mechanics combined with thrilling combat.

Give orders to many different units and choose the best tactics to fight with your forces: engage in ranged attacks, cavalry charges and infantry assaults.
You’ll also be able to have different unit formations and promote your units to give them advantages in different situations and kinds of terrains.

notes.title: Shenandoah Studio is back with March to Glory!
notes.content:
https://youtu.be/CEyrVYgXuOM

March to Glory is the new thrilling strategy game in development by Shenandoah Studio, the creators of gems like Battle of the Bulge and Gettysburg: The Tide Turns!

Relive the most iconic battles that tore apart Europe during the Napoleonic age and take the lead of your Nation across 14 historical maps, ranging from France to Russia, passing through Austria, the German States and Prussia, or play with your friends in the Multiplayer mode, featuring a random map generator that will allow you to always have different experiences!

March to Glory features a unique “Promotion System” based on unit's class, in which you’ll be able to shape an army of your design and needs. Promote units according to your strategy and always take into consideration the terrain type to create the ultimate war machine!

Will you spread the seeds of the French Revolution or will you try to stop Napoleon himself?
